title: A fungus is threatening the world’s food supply. Scientists just found a new defense
caption:
A devastating fungus threatens global rice, wheat, and barley harvests, but scientists might have found a way to fight back. By re-engineering plant immune sensors, they’ve created a way for crops to 'see' and catch multiple fungal threats at once. It's a promising step toward more resilient, disease-resistant food supplies.

Source: Sciencedaily - A fungus is threatening the world’s food supply. Scientists just found a new defense
